definitions.gloss: hairline; the edge where hair begins to grow
definitions.explanation: The boundary line on the forehead or nape where hair growth starts. Most commonly refers to the front hairline on the forehead.

examples.japanese: {生|は}え{際|ぎわ}が{後退|こうたい}してきた。
{前髪|まえがみ}の{生|は}え{際|ぎわ}を{整|ととの}える。
examples.english: To tidy up the hairline around the bangs.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{生|は}え{際|ぎわ}の{後退|こうたい}を{気|き}にして、{育毛剤|いくもうざい}を{使|つか}い{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: My father started using hair growth treatment because he was worried about his receding hairline.

notes:
A compound of {生|は}え (growing, sprouting — the stem of {生|は}える) and {際|ぎわ} (edge, boundary). Refers to the line where hair starts growing, most commonly the forehead hairline.

USAGE:
Often discussed in the context of hair loss or receding hairlines, a topic of considerable concern in Japanese culture. Also used in hairstyling and beauty contexts when discussing bangs, sideburns, or nape hair.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生|は}え{際|ぎわ}が{後退|こうたい}する — the hairline recedes
- {生|は}え{際|ぎわ}が{気|き}になる — to be concerned about one's hairline
- {生|は}え{際|ぎわ}を{隠|かく}す — to hide one's hairline
- {襟足|えりあし}の{生|は}え{際|ぎわ} — the hairline at the nape

RELATED WORDS:
- {薄毛|うすげ} — thinning hair; a broader term for hair loss
- {額|ひたい} — forehead; the area where a receding hairline becomes visible
- {育毛|いくもう} — hair growth promotion; treatments for thinning hair
